Overview

Pereira is a city in RI with a population of 500,000. The capital of Colombia’s coffee region, surrounded by lush green hills and coffee plantations. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
